title: Köthe Conjecture on Nil One-Sided Ideals
exact_target: Can nil behavior in a one-sided ideal fail to produce a nonzero nil two-sided ideal? Equivalently, do two-by-two matrices over nil rings remain nil?

sources.citation: Agata Smoktunowicz, "Some results in noncommutative ring theory," Proceedings of the ICM, Madrid 2006, Vol. II, EMS, pp. 259-269.
